title: Pressure-robust ALE space-time DG method for the Stokes equations on moving domains
summary: We propose and analyze a space-time discontinuous Galerkin method for the incompressible Stokes equations on moving domains within the arbitrary Lagrangian-Eulerian setting. We use a contravariant Piola map in the definition of the discrete velocity space to preserve the pointwise divergence-free property on the discrete level. We show that the method is inf-sup stable, with no constraints on the spatial mesh or the time partition.
